set.body: Acceptance criteria: consume the recorded storage/emission/byte-budget decision rather than assuming a wholesale columnar rewrite; implement only approved columnar arrays, zero-copy recording views, chunked Machine emissions, Arrow interop, or byte-budget preflight; publish chunking equivalence, order preservation, flush idempotence, deterministic output, and bounded-state laws; profile a realistic multi-million-sample recording on JVM and supported Scala.js paths with work counts, peak bytes, allocation rate, and regression thresholds.
set.title: Implement evidence-approved large-recording engine changes
